Role Description Director of Fundraising – Dubai Senior Fundraising & Project Finance Specialist BLACKBULL is seeking an experienced Director of Fundraising based in Dubai who can independently develop investor relationships and successfully arrange capital for qualifying Indian projects and companies. This is not a conventional sales or business-development position. The primary responsibility is to raise and arrange investment capital and complete fundraising transactions within agreed timelines. The successful candidate will be expected to build a strong international network of investors, financial institutions, family offices, private-credit funds, private equity investors, strategic investors, corporate institutions, and other legitimate sources of capital. Key Responsibilities - Lead fundraising mandates for qualifying Indian companies and projects through the Dubai platform. - Develop and maintain relationships with UAE and international investors, family offices, funds, financial institutions, corporate investors, and strategic capital providers. - Source and evaluate suitable investors for large-scale Indian projects. - Arrange equity, debt, structured finance, project finance, private credit, strategic investment, and other legally permissible funding structures. - Develop investment structures offering appropriate combinations of interest, profit sharing, revenue sharing, equity participation, or other agreed investor returns, subject to transaction structure and applicable law. - Identify financing opportunities involving eligible Indian real estate, commercial properties, business assets, receivables, operating cash flows, and other acceptable security. - Explore asset-backed financing structures where financing may potentially be considered up to approximately 40% of eligible asset/property value, subject to independent valuation, lender policy, due diligence, legal enforceability, and investor risk assessment. - Prepare and coordinate investment proposals, financial models, information memorandums, transaction summaries, investor presentations, term-sheet discussions, and due-diligence documentation. - Build an international investor pipeline capable of supporting multiple Indian projects rather than relying on a single funding source. - Establish long-term alliances with UAE-based and international financial and corporate institutions for recurring capital deployment into Indian opportunities. - Coordinate with legal, financial, tax, compliance, valuation, and transaction professionals to move fundraising mandates from initial assessment through financial closure. - Develop a structured Dubai–India investment and fundraising channel for repeat capital mobilisation. - Support appropriate mechanisms for monitoring project funding, investor reporting, deployment of capital, repayment/returns, and transaction-level financial controls. - Identify opportunities for reinvestment and further capitalisation of successful projects and eligible Indian assets. - Maintain strict confidentiality concerning investor information, project information, financial records, and transaction structures. Investor & Alliance Development The Director will be responsible for developing relationships with: - UAE-based family offices - International family offices - Private equity funds - Private-credit funds - Alternative investment funds - Venture capital investors - Institutional investors - Banks and financial institutions - NBFCs and other regulated lenders - Corporate investment groups - Strategic investors - High-net-worth investors - International investment advisers and capital-arranging partners The objective is to create a long-term institutional investor network capable of funding multiple qualifying Indian projects. Indian Project Funding Mandate The role will primarily focus on arranging capital for Indian businesses and projects, including: - Real estate and property-backed businesses - Infrastructure - Manufacturing - Technology and LegalTech - Healthcare - Renewable energy - Logistics - Hospitality - MSMEs - Corporate acquisitions - Business expansion - Strategic asset acquisition - Working capital and structured financing - Other commercially viable projects approved by BLACKBULL Funding structures may include equity investment, project finance, structured debt, private credit, strategic capital, revenue/profit participation, or combinations thereof, depending on the project's financial profile and applicable regulatory requirements. Dubai–India Capitalisation Model The successful candidate will help develop a professional Dubai–India fundraising and investment channel, where Dubai functions as an international investor-relations and capital-arrangement hub for qualifying Indian projects. The objective is to: Identify Indian Project → Evaluate Assets & Cash Flow → Structure Funding → Connect International Investors → Complete Due Diligence → Negotiate Terms → Arrange Capital → Monitor Deployment → Facilitate Returns/Repayment → Re-capitalise Eligible Projects All transactions must be structured through appropriate legal, regulatory, tax, banking, and compliance frameworks applicable to the relevant jurisdictions. Candidate Profile We are specifically looking for a proven fundraising professional, not an individual who is primarily seeking training or an opportunity to learn fundraising. Required Experience - 8–15+ years of relevant experience in fundraising, investment banking, project finance, corporate finance, private equity, debt arranging, structured finance, or capital advisory. - Demonstrable history of successfully raising or arranging substantial capital. - Strong investor and institutional network in the UAE and/or international markets. - Ability to originate investors independently and take transactions from initial discussion to financial closure. - Strong understanding of equity and debt fundraising. - Experience with asset-backed, project-backed, cash-flow-backed, or structured investment transactions. - Strong negotiation and transaction-management skills. - Excellent financial, commercial, analytical, and presentation capabilities. - Experience working with Indian companies and Indian assets is highly desirable. - UAE/Dubai market knowledge and international investor relationships will be a significant advantage. Preferred Professional Background Candidates from investment banking, private equity, project finance, corporate finance, structured finance, debt syndication, private credit, NBFCs, alternative investments, family offices, or institutional fundraising backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Performance Expectation This position is intended for a professional who can deliver measurable fundraising outcomes. The selected candidate should be capable of: 1. Building qualified investor pipelines. 2. Securing investor meetings and transaction discussions. 3. Structuring commercially viable funding proposals. 4. Negotiating investment terms. 5. Coordinating due diligence and documentation. 6. Arranging committed capital. 7. Supporting transactions through financial closure. 8. Developing repeat investor relationships for future Indian projects. Simply providing investor contacts without progressing transactions will not be considered sufficient performance. Compensation & Benefits Equity + Salary + Performance Benefits BLACKBULL will consider a compensation structure combining: - Competitive fixed salary - Equity participation, subject to agreed terms and eligibility - Performance-based incentives - Transaction/fundraising success incentives, where legally and commercially appropriate - Additional benefits based on experience, responsibility, and transaction performance The final compensation structure will be mutually agreed based on the candidate's experience, investor network, fundraising track record, and expected responsibilities. Important Special Condition This is a special-condition senior fundraising mandate. BLACKBULL is specifically interested in professionals who can demonstrate that they have previously raised, arranged, or successfully closed significant investment or financing transactions. Candidates should apply only if they have the professional network, transaction experience, and execution capability required to undertake fundraising mandates independently. The position is not intended as a training or learning opportunity. The core requirement is the ability to deliver fundraising results. Hybrid Dubai Position The position is based in Dubai, UAE, with a hybrid working arrangement. The professional will be expected to participate in investor meetings, institutional discussions, transaction negotiations, and other business activities in Dubai whenever required. The role will principally manage Indian fundraising mandates through the Dubai platform, with international investor and institutional relationship development forming a core part of the position. Strategic Objective The long-term objective is to establish BLACKBULL's Dubai platform as an international fundraising and capital-arrangement hub for qualifying Indian businesses and projects, creating sustainable relationships between international capital providers and Indian opportunities. If you have the investor network and proven ability to raise and arrange capital for substantial Indian projects, this opportunity is designed for you.
